The honest MVP should present a five-state player timeline over the versioned 54-minute community model. Its hero is not elapsed cycle time: it is the large countdown to the next meaningful event—especially expected ordinary-Vermin return during recovery, warning start during the active world, and Ruptura impact during warning. A whole-cycle proportional rail is useful for orientation, but short phases need minimum-width steps or an exact next-events list.

Opportunities remain independent, versioned evidence records rather than consequences embedded in phase logic. Each card carries its own range, action, caveat, evidence class, confidence, applicable game build, and source snapshot. Show at most two prioritized cards, retain uncertainty in player-facing wording, and never describe recovery as guaranteed safety.

Alerts must distinguish enemy return from Ruptura through text, borders/symbols, sound, and haptics; expose capability and permission state; support one-cycle mute; schedule against absolute dates; deduplicate occurrences; and collapse missed cues into the current-state message. Native behavior must keep the screen awake only while the monitor is active, avoid background-audio keep-alives, use normal notifications on older iOS, and reserve AlarmKit for an explicitly armed next event or Watch Session—not an endless recurring alarm.
